title: Trust Accounting Memo: The Monthly Interest Credit on Resident Trust Fund Accounts
content:
Funds above the tier's interest-bearing threshold earn interest in the pooled account and the interest belongs to the resident. For each Resident Trust Fund Accounts account, a month's interest credit is:

> the month's average daily balance less the interest-bearing threshold (never below zero), multiplied by the annual rate in effect for the month, multiplied by the number of days in the month divided by 365, rounded half up to the cent, and posted on the last day of the month. A month whose credit rounds below the minimum credit posts nothing.

The threshold of the tier in effect on the last day of the month applies, so a resident whose Medicaid eligibility began during the month earns interest above the Medicaid threshold for that whole month. A month is credited once: the account's ledger may hold only one interest credit for a given month.

The threshold, rate, day count, rounding and minimum credit of each tier are those of the product's interest schedule.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

**Example 1.** A Non-Medicaid tier account (threshold $100.00) has an average daily balance of $1347.90 in a 31-day month of 2026, when the rate is 0.4 percent a year.
1. Balance above the threshold: $1247.90.
2. Times 0.4 percent: 4.9916.
3. Times 31 days divided by 365: 0.42394.
4. Rounded half up to the cent: **$0.42**, credited on the 31st.

**Example 2.** A Medicaid tier account (threshold $50.00) averages $61.25 over a 30-day month of 2025, at 0.5 percent a year. The balance above the threshold is $11.25; times 0.5 percent is 0.05625; times 30 divided by 365 is 0.00462, which rounds to $0.00. That is below the $0.01 minimum, so no credit posts for that month.

**Example 3.** An account moves to a Medicaid tier with a tier effective date of 1 June. On 30 June the Medicaid tier is in effect, so June's whole average daily balance is measured above the $50.00 Medicaid threshold, even though the move was recorded on the account later in the month.
